parse.title: Weapon Upgrade Kit
parse.text:
Introduced:  Gaining Ground Related Quests:  Assault Weapons, Singularity Weapons, Quiddity Weapons, Modified Gaerlan Weapons
Weapon Upgrade Kit
Value: 5
10 Burden Units

A weapon upgrade kit.

Use this upgrade kit to enhance various types of non-loot weapons. As time goes on more weapons may be adapted to work with these kits.


This item cannot be sold.

Notes

  • Obtained by using an Weapon Upgrade Kit Containment Gem.
  • May be used on:
    • Assault Weapons
    • Singularity Weapons
    • Quiddity Weapons
    • Modified Gaerlan Weapons - Added during the A Growing Twilight event.
